# vcinvestments

> Independent directory of venture capital firms: theses, teams, funds and portfolios. Data from public sources, verified 2026-10-15.

## Firms

- [Konvoy Ventures](https://diegodeleondev.github.io/vcinvestments/konvoy/): Denver, CO venture capital firm (official site: https://konvoy.vc). Invests at the early stage in interactive entertainment, deep tech and critical industries. Konvoy Fund III: $150M (July 2022). Founded by Josh Chapman, Jason Chapman and Jackson Vaughan. 51 portfolio companies, including Axie Infinity (Sky Mavis), Ready Player Me, Carry1st, GameFam, Edgegap, k-ID and Lux Aeterna.
